'''Molecular acid''' was a type of [[Acid/Legends|acid]]. The substance was commonly used for sabotage, and was capable of defeating [[security lock]]s and [[Binders/Legends|binders]]. Molecular acid could be loaded into [[Dart/Legends|darts]] as a weapons payload.<ref name="EGWT" />
